entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I began to think aloud as I reflect..."
entries.dialogueText: I began to think aloud as I reflected upon the circumstances surrounding the events that led me here.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No surprise that those claiming to..."
entries.dialogueText: "No surprise that those claiming to serve the public ended up defying the Crown."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All they did was twist our laws an..."
entries.dialogueText: "All they did was twist our laws and traditions to suit their own purposes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I never wanted it to come to this,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I never wanted it to come to this, but I did what needed to be done."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I refused to let them steer this k..."
entries.dialogueText: "I refused to let them steer this kingdom off course."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I always strived to protect and up..."
entries.dialogueText: "I always strived to protect and uphold the integrity of these lands."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Even when others questioned me, I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even when others questioned me, I remained resolute."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Democracy... what a joke.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Democracy... what a joke.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mob rule is more like it!""
entries.dialogueText: "Mob rule is more like it!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Chaos-driven, pandering to the mas..."
entries.dialogueText: "Chaos-driven, pandering to the masses."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Quixotic idealism fraught with ins..."
entries.dialogueText: "Quixotic idealism fraught with insurmountable problems."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Like giving a child a hammer -- ev..."
entries.dialogueText: "Like giving a child a hammer -- everything’s a nail."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Once full of voices, this hall now..."
entries.dialogueText: "Once full of voices, this hall now reflects the Crown’s true strength."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The old order thought they could c..."
entries.dialogueText: "The old order thought they could cling to power, but now, it’s mine to reshape."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""These so-called delegates thought..."
entries.dialogueText: "These so-called delegates thought they held power but never grasped true leadership."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A monarchy was the only way to ensu..."
entries.dialogueText: A monarchy was the only way to ensure stability and order.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My eyes fell on an old banner drape..."
entries.dialogueText: My eyes fell on an old banner draped over a bench.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Justice demanded action, not compl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Justice demanded action, not complacency."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "More like, "The Strength of the Cro..."
entries.dialogueText: More like, "The Strength of the Crown," I thought to myself.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I picked up the banner and held it..."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up the banner and held it out. It read, "Voice of the People, Strength of the Nation!"
entries.menuText: Pick up banner.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I ignored it as I continued walking..."
entries.dialogueText: I ignored it as I continued walking toward the center of the room, relishing the moment.
entries.menuText: Ignore banner.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I had no choice but to cut them do..."
entries.dialogueText: "I had no choice but to cut them down before they could strike. Rizia's survival was at stake."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You give them an inch of trust, an..."
entries.dialogueText: "You give them an inch of trust, and they'll take a mile of betrayal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They concealed their true loyalty..."
entries.dialogueText: "They concealed their true loyalty while sharpening their knives."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In it resided Rizia's constitution,..."
entries.dialogueText: In it resided Rizia's constitution, a relic of this kingdom's brief experiment with democracy.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Still, I can't help but wonder if..."
entries.dialogueText: "Still, I can't help but wonder if there could have been another way."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's why I was destined to become..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's why I was destined to become king. It was my duty, my purpose to bring these lands back under control."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I reached the center of the chamber..."
entries.dialogueText: I reached the center of the chamber, I noticed the display case near the podiums.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“To think that this unassuming docu..."
entries.dialogueText: “To think that this unassuming document could have incited such turmoil and challenge to my rule.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A good idea in theory but inevitab..."
entries.dialogueText: "A good idea in theory but inevitably flawed."
